headline: Francis Marion win at Emmanuel and have lost just once
dek: Francis Marion's win at Emmanuel on Saturday was their eighth of the season against a single defeat, and they have conceded seven goals in all. Only Young Harris and Lees-McRae have yet to lose, and Francis Marion sit level with Young Harris at the top of the conference table.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Chowan's 24 goals, from twelve different scorers, are the most in the conference and have still come with two defeats; the scoring is spread widely and has not bought a clean record.

wire.line: King have lost every match they have played; Lees-McRae have yet to lose one.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Fourteen matches dated before today carry no result at all, the earliest Converse's home match against Spartanburg Methodist and the latest Virginia State's home match against Mount Olive.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: King have lost all eight of their matches, scoring four goals and conceding twenty; only three players have scored for them.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Enzo Joly, a freshman, has seven of Emmanuel's sixteen goals, from 28 shots.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lees-McRae have won seven matches and drawn two and are yet to lose; they have conceded four goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Erskine have drawn one match and lost seven without a win, conceding 23 goals; only King are also without a victory.

last_match.line: Francis Marion have won every conference match they have played; Emmanuel have now lost consecutive conference matches, both to sides above them.

next_match.line: Francis Marion have yet to drop a point in conference play; Ferrum have lost both of their most recent conference matches, at home and then away.
